claim: Coswara contributed 2114 participants with known binary labels
interpretation_boundary: Unknown and recovered/other label groups were excluded from supervised analyses

claim: COUGHVID external evaluation used 8331 unique recording UUIDs
interpretation_boundary: COUGHVID has no persistent person identifier, so repeated submissions cannot be clustered

claim: The audio audit classified most source recordings as usable
interpretation_boundary: Quality categories describe file usability and are not disease labels

claim: The combined engineered representation contained three feature families
interpretation_boundary: Do not describe this representation as ComParE+IS10 alone

claim: Feature selection retained the 800 highest-ranked source-training features
interpretation_boundary: Selection was frozen before external transfer; the retrospective temporal analysis reuses this source workflow

claim: Four conventional model families were evaluated with the same selected cough representation
interpretation_boundary: Model-family consistency is more important than identifying a winning model

claim: Multimodal probabilities were aggregated per participant before fusion
estimate: uniform mean; validation-weighted mean; validation-trained logistic stack
interpretation_boundary: Fusion parameters and operating threshold were estimated without using the test set

claim: The selected internal multimodal source model achieved AUROC 0.897
interpretation_boundary: Cough+speech internal result; not directly comparable with cough-only external transfer

claim: The internal multimodal estimate was stable over four seeds
interpretation_boundary: Seed variation does not measure cohort sampling uncertainty

claim: LightGBM cough discrimination declined under external transfer
interpretation_boundary: Fixed modality and model family

claim: The LightGBM cough AUROC decline had a positive independent-bootstrap interval
denominator: 316 source participants and 8331 target recording UUIDs
interpretation_boundary: Independent two-sample bootstrap at each dataset's available analysis-unit level

claim: SVC cough discrimination declined under external transfer
interpretation_boundary: Fixed modality and model family

claim: The SVC cough AUROC decline had a positive independent-bootstrap interval
denominator: 316 source participants and 8331 target recording UUIDs
interpretation_boundary: Independent two-sample bootstrap at each dataset's available analysis-unit level

claim: CatBoost cough discrimination declined under external transfer
interpretation_boundary: Fixed modality and model family

claim: The CatBoost cough AUROC decline had a positive independent-bootstrap interval
denominator: 316 source participants and 8331 target recording UUIDs

claim: XGBoost cough discrimination declined under external transfer
interpretation_boundary: Fixed modality and model family

denominator: 316 source participants and 8331 target recording UUIDs

claim: WavLM also failed to transport
interpretation_boundary: Supporting architecture check; training recipe differs from engineered models

claim: CNN-BiGRU also failed to transport
denominator: 636 Coswara test recordings; 8331 COUGHVID recording UUIDs
interpretation_boundary: Supporting recording-level architecture check; source split remains participant-disjoint but metrics were not participant-aggregated

claim: At sensitivity at least 0.90 against status_SSL, external specificity was low
interpretation_boundary: Descriptive agreement with a semi-supervised pseudo-label, not clinical sensitivity or specificity

claim: At sensitivity at least 0.90 against status_SSL, external precision was near positive-label prevalence
interpretation_boundary: Descriptive pseudo-label operating-point analysis, not clinical PPV

claim: Target-domain Platt scaling improved probability calibration but not ranking
estimate: LightGBM AUROC 0.5391 unchanged; Brier 0.0756 to 0.0330; ECE 0.0992 to 0.00017
interpretation_boundary: Target calibration and evaluation subsets were separate; not a deployable unsupervised correction

claim: A retrospective early-to-late stress test yielded lower discrimination
interpretation_boundary: Different modality/model from the internal headline and therefore not a controlled pair

claim: The temporal estimate was stable over three seeds
interpretation_boundary: Does not remove the feature-selection provenance limitation

claim: The temporal cohorts differed markedly in prevalence
interpretation_boundary: High temporal AUPRC is not evidence of strong transport because the test prevalence is 0.804

claim: Early and late feature rankings had low overlap
interpretation_boundary: Exploratory; periods also differ in class prevalence and recruitment

claim: Collection-context metadata predicted source labels strongly
interpretation_boundary: Association does not identify a causal shortcut in the audio model

claim: Retraining the metadata model after label permutation removed discrimination
interpretation_boundary: Sanity check against implementation leakage

claim: Recording-protocol variables dominated grouped metadata permutation importance
estimate: importance share 0.7169 to 0.9343; recording year largest
interpretation_boundary: Permutation importance is predictive attribution, not a causal effect

claim: A source-versus-target classifier distinguished the datasets
interpretation_boundary: Exploratory evidence of covariate shift

claim: One quarter of external samples were outside the source probability band
interpretation_boundary: Probability-band diagnostic, not a formal proof of positivity violation

claim: Symptoms plus the best aligned audio candidate exceeded symptoms alone numerically
interpretation_boundary: 95% bootstrap CI -0.0051 to 0.1491; DeLong p=0.104; exploratory and inconclusive

claim: Adding selected-fusion audio to full context metadata provided little incremental discrimination
interpretation_boundary: 95% bootstrap CI -0.0264 to 0.0403; DeLong p=0.538; exploratory

claim: Coswara and COUGHVID binary outcomes were not assumed to have identical clinical semantics
interpretation_boundary: External findings are dataset-transfer results, not transport between identical diagnostic reference standards

claim: Primary external claims concern cough only
estimate: COUGHVID has no breath or speech inputs
interpretation_boundary: The study does not externally validate multimodal fusion

claim: The participant and temporal protocols used the reported cohort sizes and cut dates
denominator: 2114 known-label Coswara participants before complete-case filtering
interpretation_boundary: Complete-case model denominators can be smaller than protocol assignment counts

claim: The selected source multimodal fusion had the reported threshold metrics
interpretation_boundary: Source-only cough+speech fusion; not directly comparable with cough-only external transfer

claim: The time-stratified source fusion had the reported performance
interpretation_boundary: Different selected modalities and fusion from the source headline

claim: The temporal test AUPRC was high relative to its very high prevalence
denominator: 411 complete-case model participants; 424 assigned test participants
interpretation_boundary: AUPRC must be interpreted against prevalence and not compared directly across endpoints

claim: Symptoms and protocol/demographic metadata separately predicted source labels
interpretation_boundary: Predictive association does not establish direct use by an audio model

claim: Full-context grouped permutation attribution was concentrated in recording protocol
interpretation_boundary: Grouped permutation importance is descriptive predictive attribution

claim: The audio-only candidate in the symptoms-aligned incremental analysis had lower point discrimination than the combined model
interpretation_boundary: Exploratory small-sample comparison; combined-minus-metadata interval included zero

claim: The processed COUGHVID binary endpoint was bound to status_SSL
estimate: 285 positive; 8046 negative; zero disagreement in the binding check
interpretation_boundary: status_SSL is a semi-supervised pseudo-label rather than a harmonized clinical reference standard
